verses.geez: እለ፡ ጸምኡ፡ ይሖሩ፡ ኀበ፡ ማይ፡ ወእለሂ፡ አልቦሙ፡ ወርቀ፡ ይሖሩ፡ ወይሣየጡ፤ ወይስተዩ፡ ዘእንበለ፡ ወርቅ፡ ወይነ፡ ወሐሊበ።
verses.translation: Ye that thirst, go to the water, and all that have no money, go and buy; and eat and drink wine and fat without money or price.

translations.lxx: Ye that thirst, go to the water, and all that have no money, go and buy; and eat and drink wine and fat without money or price.
translations.kjv: Ho, every one that thirsteth, come ye to the waters, and he that hath no money; come ye, buy, and eat; yea, come, buy wine and milk without money and without price.
translations.ron: Cei ce sunteţi însetaţi, mergeţi la apă, şi cei care nu aveţi argint, mergeţi de cumpăraţi şi mâncaţi, mergeţi şi cumpăraţi fără de argint şi fără preţ vin şi grăsime.

verses.geez: ለምንት፡ ትሣየጡ፡ በወርቅ፤ ኢይከውነክሙኑ፡ ለጽጋብ፡ ፃማክሙ፤ ስምዑኒ፡ ወትበልዑ፡ በረከተ፡ ወትትፌሣሕ፡ በበረከት፡ ነፍስክሙ።
verses.translation: Wherefore do ye value at the price of money, and give your labour for that which will not satisfy? hearken to me, and ye shall eat that which is good, and your soul shall feast itself on good things.

translations.lxx: Wherefore do ye value at the price of money, and give your labour for that which will not satisfy? hearken to me, and ye shall eat that which is good, and your soul shall feast itself on good things.
translations.kjv: Wherefore do ye spend money for that which is not bread? and your labour for that which satisfieth not? hearken diligently unto me, and eat ye that which is good, and let your soul delight itself in fatness.
translations.ron: Pentru ce cheltuiţi argintul vostru pentru un lucru care nu hrăneşte şi câştigul muncii voastre pentru ceva care nu vă satură? Ascultaţi-Mă pe Mine şi veţi mânca cele bune şi întru bunătăţi se va desfăta sufletul vostru.

verses.geez: ወትልዉ፡ ፍኖትየ፤ ወስምዑኒ፡ ወተሐዩ፡ በበረከት፡ ነፍስክሙ፡ ወእሠርዕ፡ ለዳዊት፡ ሥርዓተ፡ ጽድቅ፡ ዘለዓለም።
verses.translation: Give heed with your ears, and follow my ways: hearken to me, and your soul shall live in prosperity; and I will make with you an everlasting covenant, the sure mercies of David.

translations.lxx: Give heed with your ears, and follow my ways: hearken to me, and your soul shall live in prosperity; and I will make with you an everlasting covenant, the sure mercies of David.
translations.kjv: Incline your ear, and come unto me: hear, and your soul shall live; and I will make an everlasting covenant with you, even the sure mercies of David.
translations.ron: Luaţi aminte cu urechile voastre şi mergeţi pe căile Mele. Ascultaţi-Mă pe Mine şi viu va fi sufletul vostru. Voi face cu voi legământ veşnic, dându-vă îndurările Mele cele făgăduite lui David.

verses.geez: እስመ፡ ናሁ፡ ምእመነ፡ ረሰይክዎ፡ ወስምዓ፡ ለአሕዛብ፣፡ መስፍነ፡ ወመኰንነ፡ ለአሕዛብ።
verses.translation: Behold, I have made him a testimony among the Gentiles, a prince and commander to the Gentiles.

translations.lxx: Behold, I have made him a testimony among the Gentiles, a prince and commander to the Gentiles.
translations.kjv: Behold, I have given him for a witness to the people, a leader and commander to the people.
translations.ron: Iată l-am făcut mărturie popoarelor, căpetenie şi stăpânitor peste neamuri.

verses.geez: ሕዝብ፡ እለ፡ ኢየአምሩከ፡ ይጸውዑከ፤ ወሕዝብ፡ እለ፡ ኢይሌብዉከ፡ ይትመሐፀኑ፡ ኀቤከ፡ በእንተ፡ እግዚአብሔር፡ አምላክከ፡ ቅዱሰ፡ እስራኤል፡ እስመ፡ ውእቱ፡ አክበረከ።
verses.translation: Nations which know thee not, shall call upon thee, and peoples which are not acquainted with thee, shall flee to thee for refuge, for the sake of the Lord thy God, the Holy One of Israel; for he has glorified thee.

translations.lxx: Nations which know thee not, shall call upon thee, and peoples which are not acquainted with thee, shall flee to thee for refuge, for the sake of the Lord thy God, the Holy One of Israel; for he has glorified thee.
translations.kjv: Behold, thou shalt call a nation that thou knowest not, and nations that knew not thee shall run unto thee because of the LORD thy God, and for the Holy One of Israel; for he hath glorified thee.
translations.ron: Iată, tu vei chema popoare pe care nu le ştii şi popoare care pe tine nu te-au cunoscut vor alerga la tine, pentru Domnul Dumnezeul tău şi pentru Sfântul lui Israel, căci El te preamăreşte.

verses.translation: Seek ye the Lord, and when ye find him, call upon him; and when he shall draw nigh to you,

translations.lxx: Seek ye the Lord, and when ye find him, call upon him; and when he shall draw nigh to you,
translations.kjv: Seek ye the LORD while he may be found, call ye upon him while he is near:
translations.ron: Căutaţi pe Domnul cât Îl puteţi găsi, strigaţi către Dânsul cât El este aproape de voi.

verses.geez: ይኅድግ፡ ኃጥእ፡ ፍኖቶ፡ ወብእሲኒ፡ ዓማፂ፡ ምክሮ፤ ወይትመየጥ፡ ኀበ፡ እግዚአብሔር፡ ወይሠሀሎ፡ እንከ፡ እስመ፡ ብዙኀ፡ የኀድግ፡ ለክሙ፡ ኃጢአተክሙ።
verses.translation: let the ungodly leave his ways, and the transgressor his counsels: and let him return to the Lord, and he shall find mercy; for he shall abundantly pardon your sins.

translations.lxx: let the ungodly leave his ways, and the transgressor his counsels: and let him return to the Lord, and he shall find mercy; for he shall abundantly pardon your sins.
translations.kjv: Let the wicked forsake his way, and the unrighteous man his thoughts: and let him return unto the LORD, and he will have mercy upon him; and to our God, for he will abundantly pardon.
translations.ron: Cel rău să lase calea lui şi omul cel nelegiuit vicleniile lui şi să se întoarcă spre Domnul, căci El Se va milostivi de dânsul, şi către Dumnezeul nostru cel mult iertător.

verses.geez: እስመ፡ ኢኮነ፡ ምክርየ፡ ከመ፡ ምክርክሙ፣፡ ወኢኮነ፡ ፍኖትየ፡ ከመ፡ ፍኖትክሙ፡ ይቤ፡ እግዚአብሔር።
verses.translation: For my counsels are not as your counsels, nor are my ways as your ways, saith the Lord.

translations.lxx: For my counsels are not as your counsels, nor are my ways as your ways, saith the Lord.
translations.kjv: For my thoughts are not your thoughts, neither are your ways my ways, saith the LORD.
translations.ron: Căci gândurile Mele nu sunt ca gândurile voastre şi căile Mele ca ale voastre, zice Domnul.

verses.geez: በከመ፡ ይርኅቅ፡ ሰማይ፡ እምድር፡ ከማሁ፡ ይርኅቅ፡ ፍኖትየ፡ እምፍኖትክሙ፡ ወሕሊናየ፡ እምሕሊናክሙ።
verses.translation: But as the heaven is distant from the earth, so is my way distant from your ways, and your thoughts from my mind.

translations.lxx: But as the heaven is distant from the earth, so is my way distant from your ways, and your thoughts from my mind.
translations.kjv: For as the heavens are higher than the earth, so are my ways higher than your ways, and my thoughts than your thoughts.
translations.ron: Şi cât de departe sunt cerurile de la pământ, aşa de departe sunt căile Mele de căile voastre şi cugetele Mele de cugetele voastre.

verses.geez: ከመ፡ ሶበ፡ ይወርድ፡ ዝናም፡ እምሰማይ፡ ወበረድ፡ ወኢየኀድግ፡ እስከ፡ ሶበ፡ ያረውያ፡ ለምድር፡ ወያበቍል፡ ወያሠምር፣፡ ወይሁብ፡ ዘርአ፡ ለዘራኢ፡ ወእክለ፡ ለሲሳይ።
verses.translation: For as rain shall come down, or snow, from heaven, and shall not return until it have saturated the earth, and it bring forth, and bud, and give seed to the sower, and bread for food:

translations.lxx: For as rain shall come down, or snow, from heaven, and shall not return until it have saturated the earth, and it bring forth, and bud, and give seed to the sower, and bread for food:
translations.kjv: For as the rain cometh down, and the snow from heaven, and returneth not thither, but watereth the earth, and maketh it bring forth and bud, that it may give seed to the sower, and bread to the eater:
translations.ron: Precum se coboară ploaia şi zăpada din cer şi nu se mai întoarce până nu adapă pământul şi-l face de răsare şi rodeşte şi dă sămânţă semănătorului şi pâine spre mâncare,

verses.geez: ከማሁ፡ ውእቱ፡ ቃልየ፡ ዘይወፅእ፡ እምአፉየ፤ ኢይትመየጥ፡ እስከ፡ ይገብር፡ ኵሎ፡ ዘፈቀድኩ፡ ወእሤርኅ፡ ፍኖትየ፡ ወትእዛዝየ።
verses.translation: so shall my word be, whatever shall proceed out of my mouth, it shall by no means turn back, until all the things which I willed shall have been accomplished; and I will make thy ways prosperous, and will effect my commands.

translations.lxx: so shall my word be, whatever shall proceed out of my mouth, it shall by no means turn back, until all the things which I willed shall have been accomplished; and I will make thy ways prosperous, and will effect my commands.
translations.kjv: So shall my word be that goeth forth out of my mouth: it shall not return unto me void, but it shall accomplish that which I please, and it shall prosper in the thing whereto I sent it.
translations.ron: Asa va fi cuvântul Meu care iese din gura Mea; el nu se întoarce către Mine fără să dea rod, ci el face voia Mea şi îşi îndeplineşte rostul lui.

verses.translation: For ye shall go forth with joy, and shall be taught with gladness: for the mountains and the hills shall exult to welcome you with joy, and all the trees of the field shall applaud with their branches.

translations.lxx: For ye shall go forth with joy, and shall be taught with gladness: for the mountains and the hills shall exult to welcome you with joy, and all the trees of the field shall applaud with their branches.
translations.kjv: For ye shall go out with joy, and be led forth with peace: the mountains and the hills shall break forth before you into singing, and all the trees of the field shall clap their hands.
translations.ron: Şi voi cu veselie veţi ieşi şi în pace veţi fi călăuziţi; munţii şi colinele vor izbucni în strigăte de veselie înaintea voastră şi toţi copacii câmpului vor bate din palme!

verses.geez: ወህየንተ፡ ሦክ፡ ይበቍል፡ ኤላጡኑስ፡ ወህየንተ፡ ክርዳድ፡ ዕፀ፡ ሕቍ።
verses.translation: And instead of the bramble shall come up the cypress, and instead of the nettle shall come up the myrtle: and the Lord shall be for a name, and for an everlasting sign, and shall not fail.

translations.lxx: And instead of the bramble shall come up the cypress, and instead of the nettle shall come up the myrtle: and the Lord shall be for a name, and for an everlasting sign, and shall not fail.
translations.kjv: Instead of the thorn shall come up the fir tree, and instead of the brier shall come up the myrtle tree: and it shall be to the LORD for a name, for an everlasting sign that shall not be cut off.
translations.ron: În locul spinilor va creşte Chiparosul şi în locul urzicii va creşte mirtul. A Domnului fi-va slava, spre veşnică şi nepieritoare pomenire.
